item.tib: rtsa ba gcig la las ka gsum
item.coloph: bdag 'dra phung bon mgo dmar gyis/ yid bzhin nor bu'i gdams ngag yin/ stag la me 'bar nyid kyis bstan/ rtsa ba gcig la las ka gsum/ bod na yod pa ma yin te/ pom ra gnyen gyi rtse mor sbas/ nang gter du byas pa lags so/ 'chi bdag bdud las thar bar shog bon gyi bstan pa dar bar shog sa ma ya/ (?) me ri rlung ri chu ri gsum gyis rgyas gdab bo/ gtor zlog 'chi bdag mun sel/ byad zlog rkyen zlog yams zlog so (go)sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
